latest_commit.message: worker-c: Deterministic handling of same-clock conflicting same-record revisions

validation.qualification: Matching executor result PASS and required targeted/full pytest; no planner-side pytest executed.

quality_audit.point_in_time: FlowObservation.visible_at rejects unknown/future availability; handoff _visible_normalized first PIT-filters and effective<=as_of; existing delayed-correction tests.
quality_audit.clocks: effective_at_ms, available_at_ms, observed_at_ms separate; available<=observed enforced; latest revision rank available/observed/revision; source evidence and scoring freshness have separate clock fields.
quality_audit.revision: Current commit deterministically resolves equal-ranked conflicting values using observation_id/value and flags CONFLICTING_EQUAL_RANK_VALUES. But identical observation_id/value with conflicting provenance/context_only still has an unbroken sort tie.
quality_audit.asset_identity: revision_key includes uppercase asset; economic-event dedup groups family/metric/asset/event ID; BTC/ETH isolation regression present.
quality_audit.economic_event_dedup: Only explicit economic_event_id grouped; cross-provider quality/attribution/observed/source/revision tie-break; distinct assets preserved.
quality_audit.source_provenance: source_record_id, revision, provenance retained in FlowObservation; observation_id payload omits provenance and context_only; equal-rank same-value tie can choose arbitrary provenance.
quality_audit.context_only: handoff._is_context_only reads provenance.context_only; _visible_normalized dedups before handoff scoring/context split; equal-rank same-ID candidates with differing context_only can alternate scoring eligibility by input order.
quality_audit.missingness: Unknown available_at excluded; handoff family_support and evidence_health separate scoring_missing and context_only freshness; upstream tie may cause scoring_missing to change by input order.
quality_audit.tests: test_contracts_normalization.py includes conflicting different-value permutations, identical duplicate test, later correction and asset isolation; does not test equal-value same-identity conflicting context_only provenance permutations.

defect.lines: 138-165 (top_candidates.sort key x.observation_id,x.value), with contracts.py observation_id lines ~216-235 and handoff.py lines 25-31, 238-247
defect.reproducer: Create two FlowObservation records with same family='etf', metric='net_flow_usd', asset='BTC', source='src', source_record_id='rec', revision='1', value=100, unit='USD', effective_at_ms=1000, available_at_ms=1000, observed_at_ms=1000, one provenance={'context_only':True,'tag':'context'} and the other provenance={'context_only':False,'tag':'scoring'}. Their observation_id and sort keys are identical; select_latest_revisions([context,scoring])[0].provenance.context_only is True but reversed input picks False. normalize_and_dedup inherits this, changing handoff scoring/context counts and scoring_missing. Static code-path reproduction, not planner-executed pytest.
defect.impact: Context-only evidence may be promoted to scoring by arrival order; provenance and missingness become nondeterministic despite stable economic value.

next: If authoritative queue still empty and write safety allows, enqueue one narrow Gemini task with conservative context-only conflict handling and permutation regression; do not edit Specialist code directly.
scope: PUBLIC_ONLY; worker-control status/queue only; no main/private/prediction/API/broker/secrets/schedules/private promotion
